title: Charging and discharging a capacitor
intro: A 5 V square wave charges the capacitor through R for 5 ms, then lets it discharge for 5 ms. Change R and C and watch how fast the capacitor voltage follows.
pctLabel: Share of the 5 V step reached at 1 ms
checkPct: At 1 ms the capacitor is within 3 points of 63 % of the step.
